A '''repulsor-assisted baby stroller''' was a vehicle that could be pushed. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] were discussing political troubles on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the latter noticed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] couple pushing such a vehicle nearby.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
